name: Finance Active Customer
rule_text: Customer with recognized revenue during the trailing 90-day reporting window.
population: Customers with a recognized revenue event in the trailing 90 days.
sql_template: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id AS entity_id, c.annual_recurring_revenue AS metric_value FROM customers c JOIN revenue_events r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE r.event_type = 'recognized_revenue' AND CAST(r.event_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '{period_end}' - INTERVAL 89 DAY AND DATE '{period_end}' ORDER BY entity_id

name: Sales Active Customer
rule_text: Customer with an open or won opportunity updated during the trailing 180 days.
population: Customers represented by current pipeline activity.
filters: stage in open, won|updated_at in trailing 180 days
sql_template: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id AS entity_id, c.annual_recurring_revenue AS metric_value FROM customers c JOIN opportunities o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.stage IN ('open', 'won') AND CAST(o.updated_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '{period_end}' - INTERVAL 179 DAY AND DATE '{period_end}' ORDER BY entity_id

name: Customer Success Active Customer
rule_text: Customer with an active contract and qualifying product usage in the trailing 30 days.
population: Contracted customers demonstrating recent qualifying usage.
filters: contract status = active|qualifying = 1|usage in trailing 30 days
sql_template: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id AS entity_id, c.annual_recurring_revenue AS metric_value FROM customers c JOIN contracts ct ON ct.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN usage_events u ON u.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE ct.status = 'active' AND CAST(ct.start_date AS DATE) <= DATE '{as_of_date}' AND CAST(ct.end_date AS DATE) >= DATE '{as_of_date}' AND u.qualifying = 1 AND CAST(u.event_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '{period_end}' - INTERVAL 29 DAY AND DATE '{period_end}' ORDER BY entity_id

name: Finance Net Revenue
rule_text: Sum recognized recurring revenue events during the selected period.
population: Customers with recognized recurring revenue in the period.
sql_template: SELECT r.customer_id AS entity_id, SUM(r.amount) AS metric_value FROM revenue_events r WHERE r.event_type = 'recognized_revenue' AND CAST(r.event_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '{period_start}' AND DATE '{period_end}' GROUP BY r.customer_id ORDER BY entity_id

name: Sales Booked Revenue
rule_text: Customer recurring revenue joined to the customer book for the selected period.
population: Customer book entries with recognized recurring revenue in the period.
filters: recognized revenue event in selected period
sql_template: SELECT c.customer_id AS entity_id, SUM(r.amount) AS metric_value FROM customers c INNER JOIN revenue_events r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id AND r.event_type = 'recognized_revenue' WHERE CAST(r.event_date AS DATE) >= DATE '{period_start}' AND CAST(r.event_date AS DATE) <= DATE '{period_end}' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY entity_id

name: Finance Churned Customer
rule_text: Customer whose contract term ended without renewal by the reporting date.
population: Customers with a recorded Finance churn date on or before period end.
sql_template: SELECT c.customer_id AS entity_id, c.annual_recurring_revenue AS metric_value FROM customers c JOIN churn_events ce ON ce.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE TRY_CAST(ce.finance_churn_date AS DATE) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(ce.finance_churn_date AS DATE) <= DATE '{period_end}' ORDER BY entity_id

name: Customer Success Churned Customer
rule_text: Customer whose inactivity threshold and operational grace period elapsed by the reporting date.
population: Customers with a recorded Customer Success churn date on or before period end.
sql_template: SELECT c.customer_id AS entity_id, c.annual_recurring_revenue AS metric_value FROM customers c JOIN churn_events ce ON ce.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE TRY_CAST(ce.cs_churn_date AS DATE) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(ce.cs_churn_date AS DATE) <= DATE '{period_end}' ORDER BY entity_id
